wins: Conducted complete reconnaissance suite enabling collection of host/IP/service information before encountering blocking issues.
Leveraged structured mentor feedback to maintain consistent reward at 40 despite failure to fully breach.
fails: Failed to escalate privileges or capture required objective, resulting in 0% success rate for the episode.
Exceeded expected reliance on mentor calls (10) without resolving core exploitation steps.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance phase demonstrates promise with consistent data collection, but exploitation and post-exploitation steps require targeted callbacks to achieve success.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Exploit attempts consistently halted after SSH banner enumeration despite credentials being collected, indicating a gap between data collection and exploit execution.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration using targeted nmap scripts to capture banner/version and identify weak ciphers

skill_cards.if_condition: When valid SSH credentials are discovered via enumeration
skill_cards.then_action: Attempt automated SSH login with recorded credentials and log result for privilege escalation pathing

skill_cards.if_condition: Upon failing initial exploit, but service enumeration indicates outdated OpenSSH release
skill_cards.then_action: Pivot to secondary exploit modules or double-check privilege assumptions before retrying

memory_ops.reason: Consistent success in gathering SSH metadata which forms the foundation for later exploit attempts.

next_experiments.title: Bridging enumeration to exploitation
next_experiments.description: Automate credential validation immediately after successful SSH enumeration and log both successes and failures to reduce manual gap.

next_experiments.title: Exploit module fallback chain
next_experiments.description: Implement logic to try alternative exploitation modules once primary SSH exploit fails, referencing specific OpenSSH versions identified during recon.
